steps.message: Remove the old CSV export button and its handler — we don't use it anymore. Nothing fancy, just delete it.

Before I delete anything — this is removing a working user-facing feature, so I want a confirmation rather than taking "we don't use it anymore" as the go-ahead.

What would go:
- `index.html:7` — the `<button id="export-csv">Export CSV</button>`
- `index.html:8` — `<script src="export.js"></script>` (the only thing that loads it)
- `export.js` — the whole file; the click handler is its entire contents

Consequence: users lose the only way to get report data out of this page. There's no other export path in the repo, and nothing else references `#export-csv` or `export.js`. If anyone is still using it, or if a bookmark/doc points at it, that breaks with no fallback. It's recoverable from git history, but it is a real capability going away.
